scenarios.context: Gateway validation needs HAProxy and a pinned image. Neither is local. Host installation is forbidden. Docker reachability and remote images are unverified. ci-image may own a runtime.
scenarios.request: State the next evidence lookup and what can be claimed now.

scenarios.context: The exact capability, environment, constraints and owner source were verified this session; hashes and pins are unchanged. A repeated command reports the same local miss.
scenarios.request: Choose the next action and any recall calls.

scenarios.context: One cause-specific repair remains permitted. Its owner is unresolved. The failed operation has a sanitized mount-visibility error; local executable inventory was inspected.
scenarios.request: Describe a bounded inquiry before choosing the repair.

scenarios.context: Need a containerized HAProxy syntax gate for gateway on Windows without host installation. Local HAProxy is absent, Docker responds, the project image is remote-only, and no owner source has been inspected. No credentials are provided.
scenarios.request: Propose the capability inquiry and information it carries.

scenarios.context: Page search returned no topic. Capability-oriented reflection returned ci-image as an owner lead. Nothing in that owner repository has been inspected.
scenarios.request: State what the page miss and reflect hit prove, and the next action.

scenarios.context: Existence inquiry began at t=0 with the owner budget. At t=45 it returned one relevant owner lead with an unresolved pin location. No follow-up has run.
scenarios.request: Choose any follow-up, its remaining time boundary, and a stop rule.

scenarios.context: Existence inquiry completed after its 60-second deadline. The late text names an image owner. No source or runtime has been inspected.
scenarios.request: Report budget evidence and safe next work.

scenarios.context: Selected adapter returned an empty answer to the capability inquiry within its budget.
scenarios.request: Classify availability and describe unaffected work.

scenarios.context: Selected adapter recall access was denied; canonical repository files remain readable.
scenarios.request: Classify evidence and choose further work.

scenarios.context: The selected Hindsight transport is unreachable. A local Basic Memory CLI exists. No adapter switch or write was authorized.
scenarios.request: Choose recall behavior and any adapter use.

scenarios.context: Capability recall exceeded the owning deadline with no result; a required gate still lacks a runnable environment.
scenarios.request: State the evidence and validation status.

scenarios.context: A prior-session recall for a routine code question exceeded five seconds. This is not an existence or ownership question.
scenarios.request: State whether to extend recall and how to proceed.

scenarios.context: Memory says a runtime supports Linux-only arguments, while the current owner documents Windows constraints and changed pins. No canonical documents disagree.
scenarios.request: Assess the lead, drift status, and whether a probe is justified.

scenarios.context: Capability recall returns unrelated logging guidance with no owner for the required HAProxy gate.
scenarios.request: Choose the next bounded action and classification.

scenarios.context: An authorized read-only registry listing found the project image tag. Its Dockerfile, installed tools and compatibility have not been inspected.
scenarios.request: State exactly which proof stage is established.

scenarios.context: A permitted image starts compatibly and HAProxy runs. It lacks a second tool required by the exact gateway gate. The full gate was not invoked.
scenarios.request: Report capability and gate status.

scenarios.context: Current owner files confirm contents and pins; an authorized compatible runtime started; the exact required gate completed with exit 0.
scenarios.request: Report only the supported proof stages.

scenarios.context: Current owner source and a permitted probe establish that the available image architecture cannot run on this host.
scenarios.request: Classify the blocker without generalizing.

scenarios.context: A verified remedy requires installing a package, pulling an image or starting a container. None of these effects is authorized in this task.
scenarios.request: State the proposed action and any permission needed before execution.

scenarios.context: An authorized capability probe ran and returned a grounded runtime error. One cause-specific repair and one different retry remain.
scenarios.request: Classify and route recovery, including the retry boundary.

scenarios.context: The repair and materially different retry already failed. Recall then names a new owner lead. No parent reassessment has occurred.
scenarios.request: Choose the next action; do not execute effects.

scenarios.context: A mandatory gate is unresolved on the first native Goal turn. The host requires the same blocking condition across at least three consecutive turns to mark blocked. Work remains.
scenarios.request: Describe workflow evidence and native status separately.

scenarios.context: The selected adapter reference file is missing. A different adapter reference is readable.
scenarios.request: Choose the dependent action and any fallback.

scenarios.context: A scoped, authorized durable candidate passed admission and deduplication, but retain reports accepted/pending only.
scenarios.request: State write status and how the candidate survives.

scenarios.context: A lesson candidate is simply the current public API route and timeout value already owned by source documents.
scenarios.request: Choose its durable shape and owner.

scenarios.context: A reproduced path-provider mismatch recurred in two scoped checks. A source-backed correction uses a provider-qualified read before attributing absence; no secrets or raw logs are needed.
scenarios.request: Decide admission, scope and candidate fields; do not publish.

scenarios.context: A reusable, source-backed candidate already has a matching stored lesson by topic and canonical path.
scenarios.request: Choose creation versus update and required evidence.

scenarios.context: The only candidate is that one command transiently failed once and later worked; no causal diagnosis or reusable correction exists.
scenarios.request: Decide admission.

scenarios.context: An agent guessed that a container image contains every gateway tool; no source or execution supports it.
scenarios.request: Decide admission.

scenarios.context: A candidate embeds a synthetic session token and a raw transcript tail to explain a repair.
scenarios.request: Decide admission and preservation.

scenarios.context: A source-backed correction applies only to this repository pin layout; no fleet-wide evidence exists.
scenarios.request: Choose scope and whether to generalize.

scenarios.context: A scoped reusable correction passed admission; publication is unauthorized and the selected store is also unreachable.
scenarios.request: Preserve the candidate and report publication status.

scenarios.context: A task is mid-phase before compaction. Its checklist, validation logs and handoff are current workflow files; a memory note is being considered.
scenarios.request: Choose state ownership, curation timing and the maximum memory content.

scenarios.context: Current contract docs contradict current executable code. The repository drift registry cannot be written under this task authority.
scenarios.request: Choose dependent work and how the disagreement is reported.
